title: Ingrid Bergman's birth chart
metaDescription: Ingrid Bergman's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 5.0° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the nine placements whose signs are settled, mutable leads with four. The mutable signs sit where one season is already becoming the next — the scheme’s translators.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 5.0° Virgo — deep enough in the first decan (0°–10°) that Mercury, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 18.7° Virgo; Venus stands at 1.1° Virgo; Mars stands at 6.5° Cancer. The tradition reads thought with its feet on the ground from Mercury, attraction that grows by reliability from Venus, effort that surges when it matters from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — the Sun sextile Mars, 1.4° of separation. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, the Sun sextile Pluto at 1.9°, and Venus sextile Pluto at 1.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Mercury makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. Mercury in Virgo at 18.7° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Virgo at 1.1° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Cancer at 6.5° is in fall; Jupiter in Pisces at 25.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Cancer at 13.3° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: water 4, earth 3, air 1, fire 1 across the elements, and mutable 4, cardinal 3, fixed 2 across the modalities. Jupiter and Uranus were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aries into Taurus during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.4° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
